puzzle.hint: A powerful reminder from Surah Al-Inshiqaq about the human journey and the inevitable meeting with our Lord — a call to self-accountability and purposeful striving.
puzzle.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
puzzle.verseEn: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
